title: Practice: Gender, number, animacy; the parts of a word

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A division of nouns and pronouns (and sometimes of other parts of speech) into masculine or feminine, and sometimes other categories like neuter or common, and animate or inanimate.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Of, pertaining or belonging to the male grammatical gender, in languages that have gender distinctions.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Of, pertaining or belonging to the female grammatical gender, in languages that have gender distinctions.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Having a form which is not masculine nor feminine.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Of a word or phrase, the state of being …, dual or …, shown by inflection.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A form of a word that refers to only one person or thing.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word in the form in which it potentially refers to something other than one person or thing.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The characteristic of a noun, dependent on its living or sentient nature, which affects grammatical features.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The last morpheme of a word, added to some base to make an inflected form (such as -s in "dogs").

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The main part of an uninflected word to which affixes may be added to form inflections of the word.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The primary lexical unit of a word, which carries the most significant aspects of semantic content and cannot be reduced into smaller constituents.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A morpheme added to the beginning of a word to modify its meaning.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A morpheme added at the end of a word to modify the word's meaning.
